title: Backups
description: The backups method's result: the backups folder and every file restore can use, newest first (CONTRACT.md: backups).

directory.description: The backups folder next to the database; it may not exist yet

modifiedAt.description: When the file was written (epoch milliseconds), from the file system

kind.description: backup: daily or Back up now (<name>-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.sqlite3, retention applies); safety: the ledger as it was before a restore (<name>-before-restore-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.sqlite3, never removed automatically)
